question: Is Ubuntu `pnpm verify` plus dependency-review enough validation for this native TypeScript preview bump, or should maintainers require macOS/Windows `tsgo` smoke proof before merge?
rationale: The diff is mechanically correct, but this package supplies native platform binaries used by build/typecheck, so accepting the residual platform coverage gap is a maintainer upgrade-risk decision.

options.title: Accept current CI coverage
options.body: Merge if maintainers are comfortable that successful Ubuntu install/verify plus dependency-review is enough for this dev-tool preview bump.

options.title: Request platform smoke proof
options.body: Ask for macOS and Windows `pnpm typecheck` or equivalent `tsgo` output before landing the update.

options.title: Wait for newer preview
options.body: Let Dependabot supersede this PR if maintainers prefer not to take this specific preview build.

recommendation.title: Accept current CI coverage
recommendation.body: Merge if maintainers are comfortable that successful Ubuntu install/verify plus dependency-review is enough for this dev-tool preview bump.
